resources.string: Shows a reminder in the pantry for items expiring within 3 days. No background notifications are sent.

Every ingredient must be available in enough quantity. Common plurals such as tomatoes and eggs are recognised. Duplicate pantry entries are added together. Supported conversions: 1 kg = 1000 g; 1 l = 1000 ml; 1 tsp = 5 ml; 1 tbsp = 15 ml. Pieces cannot be converted to weight. Water, oil and other cooking ingredients are never assumed. Add them if a recipe requires them. Expired entries never count, even with reminders off.
